newsitem.title: JAPAN: Saudi cuts Aug Arab Medium price by 10 cts/bbl.
newsitem.headline: Saudi cuts Aug Arab Medium price by 10 cts/bbl.

text.p: Saudi Arabia said it will cut its August-lifting crude oil price formula to Asia by 10 cents per barrel for Arab Medium, but leave the formula for Arab Heavy unchanged, traders here said on Thursday.
Saudi Arabia also told its Asian customers that it will cut the August term crude oil price for Arab Light by 40 cents and Berri Extra Light by 50 cents, traders said.
The August term crude price for Arab Light was set at the Oman/Dubai average, a steep cut of 40 cents from July.
Berri Extra Light was set at the Oman/Dubai average plus 55 cents, down 50 cents from July, while Arab Medium was set at Oman/Dubai average minus 50 cents, down 10 cents.
The August term crude price for Arab Heavy was set at the Oman/Dubai average minus $1.20, unchanged from the previous month, traders said.
Many traders expressed surprise at the sharp cut in the latest term price for Arab Light, which one market participant described as the steepest in recent years.
Japanese traders said the move was probably due to the recent weakness in the Asian market for Middle East crude, which has prompted many Gulf oil producers to slash the official selling price.
